newsitem.title: CHINA: China orders 133 non-bank finance firms to close.
newsitem.headline: China orders 133 non-bank finance firms to close.

text.p: China's central bank has ordered 133 of the nation's 570 existing non-bank financial institutions to close, the China Securities newspaper said on Tuesday.
The order was given by the People's Bank of China after a nationwide probe into all financial institutions excluding banks which began in September, the newspaper said.
Fifty-eight other such institutions were suspended pending further investigations and the remaining 379 have been approved to re-register and to continue their business, the newspaper said.
It did not specify which institutions were probed but industry sources said they included securities brokerages, insurance firms and the finance departments of industrial companies.
Items checked included whether the institutions were operating with the approval of the central bank and whether their business went beyond approved guidelines.
